Name: Disable Joystick Chat
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
This mod prevents the Right Joystick from doing anything when you click it. Normally it opens up text chat, or if you hold it, the emote wheel. But if you only ever play singleplayer or don't care about text chatting or emotes then it just gets in the way. This mod prevents the game from recognizing it as an input.

[b]You can still use the Right Stick click for modded keybinds.[/b]

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
